title: Indirect Hot Water Heater Installation on a Steam Boiler (This Old House)

locations.name: Basement
locations.basis: Explicit transcript reference: 'in the basement Rich and here's the boiler'

summary: This Old House demonstrates converting a steam boiler that serves a house with radiant heat into a domestic hot water source by installing an indirect hot water heater. The video explains the limitations of boiler-derived hot water and then details an indirect tank with an internal coil that transfers heat from boiler water to a larger volume of potable water, eliminating the need for a direct-flame water heater. The program covers the tank’s construction (stainless steel, thick insulation), coil arrangement, filtration to protect the system, and the piping and valve hardware required (temperating valve, aquastat, relay, and circulator). It also walks through the installation steps: isolating the boiler, draining the system, mounting and leveling the tank, copper piping and soldering, adding a feed strainer, wiring controls, and starting the system to verify hot water supply.
